item.title: What Coastal Mexico Can Learn from Urban Sustainability Trends Abroad
item.description: Coastal cities in Mexico are facing growing pressure to balance tourism, local life, and environmental constraints. item.title: What Sustainable Wellness Really Looks Like in Today’s Modern World
item.description: Wellness today often feels rushed. You’re told to act only when something hurts or breaks down. Sustainable wellness takes a different direction.
